item.title: Hassabis Moves to Chair at Google DeepMind as Jeff Dean Exits Alphabet
item.summary: Demis Hassabis is stepping down as Google DeepMind CEO to become Chair and Alphabet Chief Scientist, Koray Kavukcuoglu takes operational control, and Jeff Dean departs after 27 years to co-found Discovery Loop, an Alphabet-backed AI-for-science venture — triggering a ~5% drop in Alphabet shares.
